A 19 yo woman with Type 1 DM on insulin presents to your clinic for routine follow up.  She was diagnosed with Type 1 DM 3 months ago, and she is currently taking insulin glargine 32 units at nighttime, and insulin aspart 6 units with breakfast, 6 units with lunch and 8 units with dinner.  She denies any sweats, confusion, jitteriness.  She brings her meter with her today, which shows fasting AM blood sugars of 170-190, with post-prandial sugars of 120-150.
What is the glucose target goal for this patient?
